title: Israel strikes Iranian military sites in response to October missile attack
body:
In the early hours of Saturday 26 October 2024 Israel struck military targets in Iran, which it described as a response to Iran's missile attack of 1 October involving about 180 ballistic missiles. An Israeli official said the operation took place in three waves. The first targeted Iran's air defences, and the second and third hit storage and production sites for ballistic missiles and drones.

The Israel Defense Forces listed missile manufacturing facilities, surface-to-air missile sites and additional Iranian aerial capabilities as the targets. Rear Adm. Daniel Hagari said the strikes responded to months of continuous attacks from Iran's regime and that the IDF had fulfilled its mission. Israel did not strike Iran's nuclear facilities or energy infrastructure, which drew criticism from opposition figures including Avigdor Lieberman and Yair Lapid. Israel offered no damage assessment.

The Iranian army, according to the state news agency IRNA, said it had thwarted attacks on military sites in Khuzestan, Ilam and the Tehran region and that two military personnel were killed. Iran's government said there was limited damage, and its foreign ministry called the strikes a violation of international law and the UN Charter. A senior US official said the US did not take part and called the operation targeted and proportional. President Joe Biden said the strikes appeared to have hit only military targets and expressed hope that this was the end. Qatar, Egypt and Saudi Arabia condemned the strikes.
